text: The height of abilities is to have 'volto sciolto' and 'pensieri stretti'; that is, a frank, open, and ingenuous exterior, with a prudent interior; to be upon your own guard, and yet, by a seeming natural openness, to put people off theirs.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter LIV, to his son, Bath, October 19, Old Style 1748
